title: Linear Equations in Two Variables
summary: Solutions as lines, and solving pairs of equations by graphs, substitution and elimination.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Linear Equations in Two Variables
Earlier NCERT: Linear Equations in Two Variables

objectives: I can show that a linear equation in two variables has infinitely many solutions.
I can solve a pair of equations graphically and algebraically.
I can decide whether a pair has one, no or infinitely many solutions.
misconceptions: A linear equation in two variables has only one solution.
Parallel lines have a solution far away.
You must always graph to solve.
